detail: registered one-shot confirmatory evaluation, protocol medguard-v2-derm7pt-criteria-ensemble-v1 schema 2

The attempt at sequence 0 crashed before producing or displaying any result: clustered_bootstrap_ci was called with a wrong signature (replicates= instead of n_boot=, required metric callable omitted, and its Interval return unpacked as a tuple). Test statistics were computed in-process but NONE were written to disk or displayed, so no observed outcome could have influenced any subsequent choice. Sequence 0 is retained rather than deleted; the helper is now unit-verified and the run is retried under --force.
